description: This file defines a SwiftUI view component 'SkillsSettings' and related classes for managing the display and interaction with skills in an application, including fetching skill statuses, enabling/disabling skills, installing skills, and editing environment variables.

classes.name: SkillsSettingsModel
classes.description: An observable class managing the state of skills, including fetching statuses, installing, enabling/disabling, and updating environment variables.

classes.name: EnvEditorState
classes.description: A struct representing the state of the environment variable editor for a particular skill.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches and updates the current status of all skills from the external gateway.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs a specified skill with a selected option onto a target (local or gateway).

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific skill.

methods.name: updateEnv
methods.description: Updates the environment variable or API key for a specific skill.

methods.name: isBusy
methods.description: Checks if a particular skill is currently busy performing an operation.

methods.name: withBusy
methods.description: Runs a block of code while marking the skill as busy, managing the busy state.
